other_failure_modes.name: Cross-validation data leakage
other_failure_modes.description: Transformations or imputations are applied to the entire training dataset before cross-validation splitting, causing validation data to leak into the training folds and resulting in overly optimistic CV scores.

summary: The agent provides a robust solution with good feature engineering and a proper 10-fold cross-validation setup. However, it falls short by applying median imputation before the CV split (causing cross-validation leakage), using arbitrarily hardcoded weights for the ensemble instead of tuning them, and evaluating the results using only a single metric.
